note: 'One like the Son of Man coming with the clouds of heaven' (Dan 7:13), the verse the Gospels' coming-on-the-clouds sayings draw on
'you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming with the clouds of heaven' (Mark 14:62)

Mark 14:62 takes up the words of Dan 7:13, 'coming with the clouds of heaven' (the Berean editors' note at Mark 14:62; Matt 24:30 and 26:64 likewise). The site records the wording, not what the vision meant.
